  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public abstract void initialize(SceneControl scenemanager)
      Called once before the background is first used, and everytime when AppContainerControl is changed. It is called before the background is attached to the scene graph and before setEnabled(true) is called.

    • setEnabled

      public abstract void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Called each time the user selects this background. It is called with a true argument before the background is attached to the scene graph. And called with a false argument after the background has been detached from the scene graph.
